style.styleTitle: Premier Decorations Ltd 10ft Lit FlexiBrights Pyramid LED Tree
style.toneOfVoice: Create an impressive illuminated display with this 3 m FlexiBrights® Pyramid Tree with Star. The stylish design is enhanced by 997 white and warm white LEDs, providing a bright and elegant glow across the display. Mains operated, it includes a 10 m lead cable for flexible positioning and a convenient timer function with 8 hours on followed by 16 hours off, making it easy to enjoy your display each day. Perfect for creating a stunning focal point in larger spaces, this illuminated pyramid tree adds a stylish finishing touch to Christmas displays.
